scope: Bounded orchestration, dispatch authorization, checkpoint recovery and human-governed local policy replay
changes: Dispatch revalidates owner-scoped approved plan fingerprints, immutable runtime inputs and current authorization
Provider selection and adaptive model calls use the account-scoped provider facade
Finished checkpoints cannot be overwritten or executed again; restore verifies graph anchors, event chains and call-reservation anchors
Unknown or orphaned external dispatch outcomes never retry automatically; pre-dispatch interruptions without a reservation may execute once after reauthorization
Legacy pending rows without fingerprint-bound approval produce local degraded reports and cannot initiate paid external calls
Every explicit research depth survives local policy defaults; null depth selects the approved default
Human replay accepts completed consented cases, deduplicates financial inputs and executes shared production local capabilities
Missing evidence stays unmet; candidate replay preserves original assumptions and archived mathematical hashes
Activation reruns current baseline and candidate gates before human-confirmed activation; automatic proposals exclude held-out requirements
